# pve_user (Data Source)

Reads a single PVE user account (`GET /access/users/{userid}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Look up a PVE user account.
data "pve_user" "root" {
  userid = "root@pam"
}

output "root_email" {
  value = data.pve_user.root.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) Full User ID in `name@realm` format to look up, e.g. `root@pam`.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment, up to 2048 characters.
- `email` (String) Email address, up to 254 characters.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled for login.
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration date (seconds since epoch). `0` means no expiration date.
- `firstname` (String) First name, up to 1024 characters.
- `groups` (Set of String) Set of PVE group IDs the user belongs to.
- `id` (String) Same as `userid`.
- `keys` (String) Keys for two factor auth (yubico).
- `lastname` (String) Last name, up to 1024 characters.
